lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular clusters are arranged in semi-regular vertical columns posterior to the gills. A prominent vertical triad of spots is visible in the mid-flank, followed posteriorly by a column of two larger, more widely spaced spots.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: High-intensity vertical bands intersect with the circular blobs. Notably, some vertical bands form 'U' shaped loops or closed cells around individual high-luminance nodes, creating a complex grid-like anchor system.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high intensity on the superior edge to shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of unique looped vertical white lines that deviate from standard linear stripes to frame specific high-luminance spots in the mid-lateral section.
